PART 2 — execute RULING J (the P7 evidence probe; full probe discipline binds):
The closed-cohort omission (post-entry 75+ net migration) needs its evidence leg from an AGE-STRUCTURED migration source. Hunt order: (1) ISQ interregional migration by age group — sitemap.xml slug discovery, descriptive-French slugs, GET never HEAD (Law 1b: hit the boundary the way the real consumer will); (2) StatCan components-of-growth by age via WDS — REUSE `demoflow/probes/_wds.py` and the shared test helpers. Compute the 75+ net-migration rate = |75+ net migration| / 75+ population, per modeled geography the source carries (junction via `demoflow.geography`; record which modeled geographies the source CANNOT cover rather than approximating). Extend the note VIA ITS GENERATOR only (never hand-edit a generated artifact): keep the measured no-age-axis fact; add the source + citation; the measured rates; and the TRIPWIRE EVALUATION — if ANY measured rate exceeds 1%/yr in any modeled geography×scenario, STOP: first line of your report exactly SEAT_QUESTION: (the closed-cohort altitude call escalates to the operator; do not write EVIDENCED-BOUNDED). All rates ≤ 1%/yr → the note records the omission as EVIDENCED-BOUNDED with the rates. Live-regen byte-diff proves the note. Probe discipline in full: three outcomes only (found → real values; spec-named fallback → record which fired; neither → SEAT_QUESTION, never invent); FLOOR GUARDS mutation-tested (a vacuous-but-successful response RAISES to UNKNOWN-PROBE-FAILED, never launders into a verdict); DUAL-PATH citation gates (a bare token or planted sentence FAILS); skip only on a network-class EXCEPTION TYPE with same-method reachability; every gloss/inference must be ENTAILED by the measured quantity — the review question is entailment, not value-correctness. The probe test uses the RULING-2 hardened shape (no unfilled [FILL; verdict-enum with independently-gated evidence tokens; floor-guard mutation test; fail-vs-skip on exception type; non-judging content gate).
